赵志军的脸色沉了下来。

他把车梯子一蹬，自行车稳稳停住。

“赵老三，你把刚才的话再说一遍。”

赵老三被他眼神看得有点发毛：“我、我这不是为你好嘛。”

“为我好？”赵志军往前走了一步，“你让我偷我三姐夫的手艺，出去跟他打擂台，这叫为我好？”

“什么偷不偷的，你学会了就是你自己的……”

“放你娘的屁！”赵志军一口唾沫啐在地上，“那配方是我三姐夫费尽心思琢磨出来的！

他手把手教我，是信任我！

你让我拿他教我的东西去抢他的饭碗？你当我是啥人了？”

赵老三脸上挂不住了：“你这孩子，咋不识好歹呢……”

“我不识好歹？”赵志军嗓门更大了，“我赵志军是没出息过，但我不是白眼狼！

三姐夫在我最没出息的时候拉了我一把，给我活儿干，教我手艺，给我涨工钱，还贴钱给我买自行车。

你现在让我背刺他？”

他扫了一圈在场的人。

“你们谁再跟我说这种话，别怪我翻脸！”

老槐树下一片安静。

赵老三讪讪地缩了回去，不敢再吭声。

赵志军重新骑上车，头也不回地进了村。

回到家，王桂兰正在院子里喂鸡。

看见儿子骑着自行车进门，脸上笑开了花：“志军回来了？”

“嗯。”赵志军把车停好，将卤味和点心递给她，“妈，这是三姐夫让我带回来的。

卤猪蹄和卤豆干，还有鸡蛋糕。”

王桂兰接过来，闻了闻：“真香，你三姐夫就是实在。”

赵德厚从屋里出来，围着自行车转了一圈，点点头：“好车。”

晚饭时候，赵志军把村口的事说了。

王桂兰当场就骂开了：“那个赵老三，缺了大德了！这种话也说得出口？”

赵德厚放下筷子，看着赵志军：“你咋回的？”

赵志军把当时说的话学了一遍。

赵德厚听完，端起酒杯抿了一口，重重点头。

“做得好。”

他看着儿子，眼睛里是从未有过的欣慰。

“志军，你能说出这番话，爹心里高兴。

手艺可以慢慢学，本事可以慢慢长，但人品这东西，是一辈子的事。”

“你三姐夫对咱家有恩，当初你游手好闲，谁看得起你？

就你三姐夫，给你机会，教你本事。

Zhao Zhijun's face darkened.

He stepped on the ladder and the bicycle stopped steadily.

"Zhao Laosan, say what you just said again."

Zhao Laosan was a little frightened by his eyes: "I, I'm not doing this for your own good."

"For my own good?" Zhao Zhijun took a step forward, "You let me steal my third brother-in-law's skills and go out to compete with him in the ring. Is this called for my own good?"

"Whatever you learn whether to steal or not, it becomes your own..."

"Fuck you!" Zhao Zhijun spat on the ground, "That recipe was worked out by my third brother-in-law with great effort!

He taught me step by step because he trusted me!

You want me to use what he taught me to steal his job?Who do you think I am?"

Zhao Laosan couldn't help but said: "You kid, why don't you know what is good and what is good..."

"I don't know what is good or bad?" Zhao Zhijun's voice became louder, "I, Zhao Zhijun, have never been promising, but I am not a white-eyed wolf!

My third brother-in-law helped me when I was least promising, gave me work, taught me skills, gave me a salary increase, and even gave me money to buy a bicycle.

You want me to backstab him now?"

He glanced around at the people present.

"If any of you say such things to me again, don't blame me for falling out!"

It was quiet under the old locust tree.

Zhao Laosan shrank back in disbelief, not daring to say anything anymore.

Zhao Zhijun got back on his bike and entered the village without looking back.

Back home, Wang Guilan was feeding chickens in the yard.

Seeing his son riding a bicycle through the door, his face burst into laughter: "Zhijun is back?"

"Well." Zhao Zhijun parked the car and handed her the braised meat and snacks, "Mom, my third brother-in-law asked me to bring this back.

Braised pig's trotters, braised dried beans, and chicken cakes."

Wang Guilan took it and smelled it: "It smells so good. Your third brother-in-law is genuine."

Zhao Dehou came out of the house, walked around the bicycle, and nodded: "Good car."

During dinner, Zhao Zhijun talked about what happened at the entrance of the village.

Wang Guilan scolded him on the spot: "That Zhao Laosan, he lacks a great virtue! Can you say such a thing?"

Zhao Dehou put down his chopsticks and looked at Zhao Zhijun: "How did you answer?"

Zhao Zhijun learned what he said at that time.

After Zhao Dehou heard this, he took a sip from his wine glass and nodded heavily.

"Well done."

He looked at his son, his eyes filled with relief that he had never seen before.

"Zhijun, dad is very happy that you can say this.

Craftsmanship can be learned slowly and skills can be developed slowly, but character is a lifelong thing."

"Your third brother-in-law was kind to our family. When you were doing nothing, who thought highly of you?

Your third brother-in-law will give you a chance and teach you your skills.
